North Eastern Institute of Whole Health, the largest School of Massage Therapy in New England. The Institute was awarded the best School of Massage in the United States of America in 1999. We are pleased to provide education in massage therapy for U.S. citizens. Between 1998 and 2007, N.E.I.W.H. was named and awarded by the American Business Award as "The Best School of Massage Therapy in the Manchester Area" four times.

N.E.I.W.H. occupies over 12,500 square feet of space. From study classrooms and practical training rooms, to workshop and lecture rooms as well as a student break room, the Institute is by far the best and most spacious in New England. In addition, the Institute has a clinic, wherein the students gain practical experience in massage and dealing with the general public.

When you join our Institute, you will know that you have not settled for anything but the best.
